title: Numbers To 5 Worksheets | Kindergarten Math Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: K.CC.A.3, K.CC.B.4

Give your learners extra practice with Numbers To 5! This no-prep printable pack has 6 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (9 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Number Match
  • Trace Numbers
  • Number Balloons
  • Number Memory
  • Which Number Is Different?
  • Listen & Find Numbers
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Number Match, Trace Numbers, Number Balloons, Number Memory, Which Number Is Different?, Listen & Find Numbers), so children can play, then print and practice

💰 SAVE MORE: this pack is part of the Math Bundle and the Mega Bundle.
